name: SD Rance
source:
"SD Rance" is a small ADV game starring Rance as a grade schooler, investigating the case of Mr. Ragisis' stolen ring. Appearances are made by other Rance 2 characters, Kurusu Miki from Little Vampire and two characters from Gakuen Senki, Midori and Yoko.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.miraheze.org/wiki/Rance_02:Hint_Disk]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
